# LokaLingo

> AI-powered language learning and teaching platform. Built for independent educators — Canvas whiteboard system captures real conversations, AI generates assessments, and spaced repetition drives retention. Flat $6/seat pricing with no commissions.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lokalingo.com/en): Main landing page — value proposition, how it works, pricing overview
- [For Educators](https://lokalingo.com/en/for-educators): Canvas workflow, AI assessment, student management, earnings model
- [For Learners](https://lokalingo.com/en/for-learners): 5-dimension AI progress tracking, spaced repetition, CEFR alignment
- [For Schools](https://lokalingo.com/en/for-schools): Multi-teacher management, institutional licensing
- [Use Cases](https://lokalingo.com/en/use-cases): Real-world teaching scenarios
- [Pricing](https://lokalingo.com/en/pricing): $6/seat/month flat rate, plan comparison
- [The Loka Story](https://lokalingo.com/en/the-loka-story): 23 years of language education history
- [Blog](https://lokalingo.com/en/blog): Language learning science, AI education, teaching methods

## Blog Categories

The blog (also at /ja/blog and /ko/blog) covers ~290 articles across these categories:

- Language Learning: acquisition science, spaced repetition, learner motivation
- AI: AI tutoring, teaching assistants, real-time feedback
- Technology: platform comparisons, interactive whiteboards, school management software
- Teaching Methods: communicative teaching, lesson design, assessment practice
- AI in Education: classroom AI adoption, emotion-aware tutoring
- EdTech: industry trends, tool roundups
- Language Education: market-specific guidance for English educators in Japan and Korea
- Platform, Learning Science, Assessment, Trending, Teaching: product updates, research summaries, CEFR-aligned evaluation, current topics

## Product Documentation

- [Docs](https://docs.lokalingo.com): Getting started, educator guides, learner guides, creator guides, FAQ
- [The Living Textbook](https://thelivingtextbook.lokalingo.com/en): The core product — an AI-powered curriculum platform where real lessons become living, reviewable curriculum. Educators teach on the Canvas whiteboard; AI captures the session, generates CEFR-aligned assessments and spaced-repetition review; learners track progress across 5 dimensions. Pricing is a single plan: $6 USD per active seat per month with a 14-day free trial (no credit card). Supports English, Japanese, and Korean interfaces.
